name: webpresso
description: Webpresso — Client-Side WebP Image Studio & 16-in-1 PDF Studio

scripts.build: node --check dist/pdf-engine.js && node --check dist/video-engine.js && node --check dist/app.js && (cd dist && zip -q -FS ../dist.zip .htaccess index.html styles.css app.js pdf-engine.js video-engine.js) && echo 'Build verified & flat dist.zip created for cPanel!'
scripts.start: node -e 'const http=require("http"),fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),mimes={".html":"text/html;charset=utf-8",".css":"text/css;charset=utf-8",".js":"application/javascript;charset=utf-8",".svg":"image/svg+xml"};let port=Number(process.env.PORT)||3000;const srv=http.createServer((req,res)=>{const clean=req.url.split("?")[0];let fp=path.join(__dirname,"dist",clean==="/"?"index.html":clean);if(!fs.existsSync(fp)||fs.statSync(fp).isDirectory())fp=path.join(__dirname,"dist","index.html");const ext=path.extname(fp);res.writeHead(200,{"Content-Type":mimes[ext]||"application/octet-stream"});fs.createReadStream(fp).pipe(res);});srv.on("error",(e)=>{if(e.code==="EADDRINUSE"){port++;srv.listen(port);}else throw e;});srv.listen(port,()=>console.log("\n  🚀 Webpresso running at http://localhost:"+port+"\n"));'
